scope: Private exact report metadata observation and common operation dispatch. Product report backend/export remain unavailable pending bounded product service/composition and real frontend journeys.
selection: Only report-op:<32 lowercase hex> and the explicit owned state directory. Inspect/cancel read report.request/records under strong ancestor/store/host and exact file identity checks. Never follow old case/copy/map/output paths or restart an operation. Compatible retained code can be observed without regranting that code writer authority.
watch: Use the retained exact request/header to validate every /2 row digest/state/definition/attempt/worker binding and progress. Emit org.disked.event/1 with report.operation.record or explicitly requested snapshot. Sequence belongs to the one retained attempt; observer_epoch belongs to this request only. Resume requires worker_epoch, after_sequence and after_digest matching the retained chain. A snapshot skips earlier delivery only; it does not establish unobserved execution or grant authority.
replies: A finished valid watch completes the observation even for failed/cancelled/unknown logical outcomes. A valid active finite watch returns accepted_running/5 and exact report ID. Torn history or an active worker whose actual identity is unavailable/exited/reused remains unknown/6, retaining validated rows, cursor and last accepted state where available. Invalid cursors are refused/2. Invalid complete rows never emit speculative events. Cancellation request persistence is separate from worker cancellation_observation; no rollback/cleanup or process ownership transfer.
containment: follow_ms is 0..2000, poll interval 25 ms. This bounds intentional following, not blocked Windows API latency. Private follow/queue closure does not kill the worker. Bounded product waiting still requires its common RequestChannel/BoundedRequests gate. Preflight the whole proposed reply and event batch before advancing its cursor or delivering its events, reserving 2048 bytes and 128 JSON values for a later bounded unknown diagnostic. A later failure preserves previously validated collected events/cursor/state; streamed frames already delivered remain valid. Cumulative private collected/queued delivery budget 768 KiB, at most 64 events. Shared queue retains existing 64-event/1 MiB cap.
reader: WatchReader rejects gaps, conflicting duplicates, wrong operations, observer changes, old worker epochs, binding changes, post-terminal/progress regression and unrequested snapshots without advancing the accepted cursor. Exact duplicates are idempotent. Additive observational outer fields may be retained within limits; producer schemas remain strict. Unknown required features are rejected.
availability: Syntax accepts report IDs, but the existing production composition explicitly refuses them with operation_unavailable before report metadata access. Dedicated native probes exercise the actual retained worker and pure reader; no real product frontend admission or stable persisted/public ABI is implied.
next_gate: Connect this service/profile to an explicit native report composition, bounded shared requests and actual CLI/stdio/GUI/TUI/shell journeys before evidence.export availability. Keep full DE-W034, all-platform/storage scope and owner/privilege/release gates separate.
